analysis: Independent JSON serialization and integer/string-width arithmetic only; synthetic maximum-shape data are not observations or runtime mocks.
failure_after_result_save: Save exception or enclosing until postcheck marks sequence false before emit_summary. A true sequence with result_ref None raises before writing.
general_bound: SOURCE <=281+E; COPY <=277+E, where E is JSON-escaped root content bytes without quotes. An admitted longer or escaped root can exceed512; actual guard rejects before stdout. The fixed root is the only root in the separately bound SOURCE payload.
parent_schema_limit: Parent v2 has a20-digit end ceiling; this proof deliberately uses a21-digit end, so it overbounds valid parent receipts. Maximum-shape data is not an admitted actual parent observation.
pipe_scope: Source checks FIFO and actual PC_PIPE_BUF>=512, then one nonblocking exact-count raw write. No pipe/fpathconf/native/runtime query performed; EAGAIN and other failure remain possible. No universal scheduling guarantee.
